Subject: Hosted API pricing match request — Lumina Health trial

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Lumina is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the built-in caching features. We have an internal procurement threshold to hit to keep this in our Q1 roadmap.

Quick ask: one of our other finalist vendors has offered to match their published rates but with a 30% effective discount on hosted usage for our first 12 months in exchange for a 12-month committed minimum. To be competitive, can Redwood provide a similar concession?

I attached a short usage forecast to show expected token volumes for the pilot and first-year ramp. We are looking for a written pricing package (term sheet) we can take to procurement by EOD next Wednesday.

Attachments: Lumina_usage_forecast.xlsx (xlsx)

Happy to jump on a call if helpful.

Best,
Sandeep Rao
Head of ML Engineering
Lumina Health

Sandeep — thanks for the clear ask and the forecast. Looping in Ben (account lead) and Tessa (rev ops) to confirm whether we can match a 30% concession for the first year and what the minimum commitment should be.

Ben / Tessa — please review the attached forecast and the ask below. Key constraints to consider: our published hosted rate floor, capacity routing (us-west) and whether we can commit burst capacity for the pilot. Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing match request — Lumina Health trial

Team — reviewed Sandeep's forecast and ran a quick financial model. Summary / recommendation: 

- Ask from Lumina: 30% off hosted usage for 12 months in exchange for a committed minimum of 24M tokens in year 1 (pilot + production ramp).
- Our baseline: published hosted rate yields ~ $0.18 per 1k tokens for this model class. A 30% concession brings us to ~$0.126/1k, which is below our standard commercial floor for new customers without an alternative lift (reserved capacity)

Recommendation (to present to Lumina):
1) Approve a 25% discount on hosted usage for the first 12 months (effective rate: $0.135/1k) conditional on a 12-month commitment and monthly minimums that scale: 600k tokens/mo months 1–3, 1.5M/mo months 4–9, 2.5M/mo months 10–12 (see attached proposed-pricing-terms.pdf).
2) Add a make-whole clause: if actual usage falls below the committed minimum, Lumina pays the difference at published rates pro-rated quarterly.
3) Include a one-time onboarding credit ($15k) to offset initial integration cost and reduce churn risk.

Rationale: 25% gets us most of the competitive benefit while keeping margin headroom. 30% would be ~5–7% below tolerance for hosted deals of this size without embedding reserved capacity. If leadership approves >25% we need signoff from Marcus (Sales VP) and Finance.

Attachments: proposed-pricing-terms.pdf, redlines_term-sheet.docx

--
Ben Carter
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 15:07:00 -0800
Subject: Request: authorization for >20% hosted pricing concession (Lumina Health)

Marcus — quick summary and request below. Need your authorization or guidance on escalation path.

Deal: Lumina Health (LH-2026-0911) — pilot -> production ramp, expected year-1 volume ~24M tokens (forecast attached).
Customer ask: 30% discount on hosted usage for 12 months to match competitor.
Redwood recommendation (Ben): 25% for first 12 months with stepped monthly minimums + make-whole clause + $15k onboarding credit.
Why escalate: asking for guidance because customer request exceeds our typical hosted-channel concession thresholds (>20%). Approving 25% is within reason; approving 30% will materially reduce unit margin and set a tough precedent for other enterprise deals.

Requested decision: authorize up to 25% now (we will present to customer), OR authorize up to 30% with the following hard conditions: a signed 12-month contract with 24M token minimum, a non-cancelable 6-month upfront payment equal to 40% of year-1 minimum, and explicit testimonial/reference commitment from Lumina (public case study).

I have attached Ben's proposed term sheet and the customer's forecast for context.

Attachments: proposed-pricing-terms.pdf, Lumina_usage_forecast.xlsx

Thanks — please advise.
Evelyn
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 17:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: authorization for >20% hosted pricing concession (Lumina Health)

Evelyn / team — thanks for the clear summary. After reviewing Ben's model and the forecast, I authorize a one-time, first-year 25% concession on hosted usage for Lumina Health under these firm conditions: 

1) 12-month contract with a 24M token minimum for year 1 (as modeled).
2) Payment terms: 40% of the year-1 committed minimum due upfront; remaining billed monthly.
3) Make-whole clause: shortfall billed at published hosted rates pro-rated quarterly.
4) Public case study / testimonial to be executed (marketing review signoff) within 90 days of GA.
5) This concession is strictly one-off and does not set a precedent; include explicit clause in the term sheet stating this is an exceptional commercial concession approved by Sales leadership.

If customer pushes to 30% we will decline unless they accept an additional reserved-capacity addendum (dedicated pool) which must be evaluated by infra/ops.

Marcus Lin
VP, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

[authorization: Marcus Lin — verbal + email signoff 2026-12-06 17:32 PST]
